description: Manage analyzed graphs. action='list' shows analyzed repos (one line each); action='analyze' indexes a repo folder (run once per repo, or after large structural changes); action='freshness' compares the graph to the current HEAD; action='health' reports summary coverage and circular-dependency groups. Repo resolved from the working folder when omitted.

isGithubRepo.description: For analyze: path is a GitHub URL

path.description: For analyze: local repo path (or GitHub URL with isGithubRepo=true)
